SELECT
  l.id AS lead_id,
  l.whatsapp_name,
  l.phone_number,
  l.service,
  l.city,
  l.requirement,
  l.qualification_context,
  l.channel,
  l.source_number_id,
  s.id AS seller_id,
  s.name AS seller_name,
  s.clickup_user_id,
  s.whatsapp_number AS seller_whatsapp_number,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT string_agg(
        CONCAT(
          to_char(COALESCE(m.external_timestamp, m.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
          ' ',
          CASE WHEN m.direction = 'incoming' THEN 'Cliente' ELSE 'Bot' END,
          ': ',
          COALESCE(m.text_body, CONCAT('[', m.message_type, ']'))
        ),
        E'\n'
        ORDER BY COALESCE(m.external_timestamp, m.created_at)
      )
      FROM messages m
      LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id
      WHERE (m.lead_id = l.id OR c.lead_id = l.id)
        AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND m.created_at >= COALESCE(
          (
            SELECT previous.created_at
            FROM leads previous
            WHERE previous.phone_number = l.phone_number
              AND previous.id <> l.id
              AND previous.created_at < l.created_at
              AND previous.deleted_at IS NULL
            ORDER BY previous.created_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
          ),
          c.started_at,
          l.created_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
        )
        AND m.created_at <= l.created_at + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    ),
    ''
  ) AS full_conversation,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_agg(
        json_build_object(
          'attachment_id', ma.id,
          'attachment_type', ma.attachment_type,
          'mime_type', ma.mime_type,
          'filename', ma.filename,
          'external_media_id', ma.external_media_id,
          'external_url', ma.external_url,
          'file_size', ma.file_size
        )
      )
      FROM message_attachments ma
      JOIN messages m ON m.id = ma.message_id
      LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id
      WHERE (m.lead_id = l.id OR c.lead_id = l.id)
        AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND m.created_at >= COALESCE(
          (
            SELECT previous.created_at
            FROM leads previous
            WHERE previous.phone_number = l.phone_number
              AND previous.id <> l.id
              AND previous.created_at < l.created_at
              AND previous.deleted_at IS NULL
            ORDER BY previous.created_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
          ),
          c.started_at,
          l.created_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
        )
        AND m.created_at <= l.created_at + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS attachments_json,
  COALESCE(latest_ad.output_payload, '{}'::jsonb) AS advisor_output_payload,
  COALESCE(latest_ad.input_payload, '{}'::jsonb) AS advisor_input_payload,
  latest_ad.validation_result AS advisor_validation_result
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.id = l.assigned_seller_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    ad.output_payload,
    ad.input_payload,
    ad.validation_result
  FROM advisor_decisions ad
  LEFT JOIN conversations c_ad ON c_ad.id = ad.conversation_id
  WHERE ad.lead_id = l.id
    OR c_ad.lead_id = l.id
  ORDER BY ad.created_at DESC, ad.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) latest_ad ON TRUE
WHERE l.id = $1::bigint
  AND l.deleted_at IS NULL;

WITH updated_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET
    clickup_task_id = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), l.clickup_task_id) ELSE l.clickup_task_id END,
    clickup_task_url = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN COALESCE(NULLIF($4::text, ''), l.clickup_task_url) ELSE l.clickup_task_url END,
    lead_status_id = ls.id,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM lead_statuses ls
  WHERE l.id = $1::bigint
    AND ls.code = CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'created_in_clickup' ELSE 'error' END
  RETURNING l.id, l.clickup_task_id, l.clickup_task_url
),
audit_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_logs (
    event_name,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    actor_type,
    actor_id,
    result,
    before_payload,
    after_payload,
    metadata
  )
  SELECT
    $5::text,
    'lead',
    ul.id,
    'system',
    'n8n',
    $6::text,
    '{}'::jsonb,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($7::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(NULLIF($8::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM updated_lead ul
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  ul.id AS lead_id,
  ul.clickup_task_id,
  ul.clickup_task_url,
  ai.id AS audit_id,
  $9::boolean AS comment_enabled,
  $10::text AS comment_text
FROM updated_lead ul
LEFT JOIN audit_insert ai ON TRUE;
